cases.title: Forced completed movement versus ordinary and direct entry
cases.premises: Normal map; actual translation completed; no ice/waterfall automation, interruption, transfer or additional state writes; forced route remains active through a following wait; two soot layers; player holds SOOTSACK, soot≤9997.
cases.ordered_expected: Completion general notice→post-step general notice→forced early return. Two layers erased, soot/statistic +2; global step/daycare/egg/Radar player cycles unchanged.
cases.reverse: Ordinary completed translation: one general notice, then one player-step chain/global +1. NPC completion or direct forced post-step entry: one general notice only. Ended route and automatic terrain require different premises.

cases.title: Ordinary wrap and handled order
cases.premises: Ordinary post-step, no forced route/interpreter, old global count2147483647; subscribers do not rewrite it.
cases.ordered_expected: Count wraps to0 before player subscribers and transferable-step subscribers. A later handled=true suppresses encounter and the post-step end-marker clear.
cases.reverse: Old2147483646→2147483647. Forced entry returns before increment. Event/menu encounter suppression does not erase preceding player subscribers.

cases.title: Breeding guard and direct tool preservation
cases.premises: Two ordinary non-Shadow occupied slots, default DITTO/PICHU; no plugin override; compatibility query.
cases.ordered_expected: Undiscovered guard produces compatibility0 and cycle probability0 before Ditto gender exception.
cases.reverse: Qualifying non-Ditto mate reaches relationship grade. Direct generation/collection tests occupied-slot count rather than compatibility/generated-egg flag; full-party failure follows generation and preserves pending state.

cases.title: Hatching and dynamic calendar form
cases.premises: Ordinary non-Shadow DEERLING egg stored form0, no forced form, steps1, month2, outside battle/storage; valid player/map/Pokedex, media/messages return normally; no nickname or other writes.
cases.ordered_expected: Player subscriber sets steps0→hatch core commits→presentation reads season1 and commits form/recalculation/seen form→later ordinary owned/seen-egg records.
cases.reverse: Month1 retains form0; forced form wins before dynamic query. Forced-route general notifications do not reach hatch subscriber. A presentation failure does not roll back earlier core writes.

cases.title: Calendar versus tone cache
cases.premises: Valid time/context, TIME_SHADING enabled; host04:00 tone cached; host advances to04:30.
cases.ordered_expected: At elapsed29.999 keep cache; elapsed30 refresh using host calendar to(-50,-60,-20,50). Encounter time predicates query host time independently, not tone cache.
cases.reverse: 06:30 plateau alone does not prove interpolation; 23→0 wrap exists despite equal endpoint values. Disabled shading returns existing cache. Month/weekday matching false can still write a requested name.

cases.title: Weather input and display/battle separation
cases.premises: Valid differing-ID connected transfer, enter-map weather Rain100, previous intention/display None, no other writes, normal return.
cases.ordered_expected: Local Rain/60/duration0→connection duration20. Display uses positive fixed-transition path; berry watering and encounter category modifiers read world intention, battle setup samples its own mapped values.
cases.reverse: Explicit reconstructed transfer without connection tail retains0. In-flight fade may refuse new display request. Same-type power change does not refresh display; duration20 is not20 seconds.

cases.title: Encounter opportunity and rod requests
cases.premises: Separate valid fixtures: a nonempty BugContest-only table on non-ice eligible land during an active contest; a surfing map with no tables; an OldRod-only map.
cases.ordered_expected: Contest opportunity is true with type BugContest. Surfing opportunity is true, but an empty Water type then rejects the step. A direct OldRod request with a valid candidate and normally returning battle call can succeed without movement tables.
cases.reverse: Radar normal-land lookup excludes contest. Missing requested rod candidates return false after writing the requested type and preserve the old force-single state. Opportunity does not establish battle entry.

cases.title: Fishing normal return and partial cleanup
cases.premises: Qualified rod success; valid requested candidates; no additional writers of encounter type or flags.
cases.ordered_expected: Fishing count and success statistic precede the encounter request. Type is written before candidate hooks. A normally returning battle call, including false, permits request cleanup: type cleared, force-single false, request true.
cases.reverse: First or second candidate empty: request false with type and old force-single retained. A hook or battle exception before cleanup leaves its committed prefix. Fishing success is not retroactively failure.

cases.title: Roaming source and generation identity
cases.premises: Normal species/level candidate chain; legal LATIAS selection and transient association; single foe with override permitted; no partner, Radar, Safari, contest or plugins; core normally returns escape result 3. Virus chance is an explicit 65536 variant; newly created individuals are uninfected. Compare generation only.
cases.ordered_expected: First encounter creates one temporary and one persistent individual, with two creation notifications and infection statistic +2 during generation. Revisit creates one temporary individual and reuses the persistent one: one notification and +1. Post-cleanup notification uses the incoming individual.
cases.reverse: Supplying an existing individual when the persistent one exists creates neither. Persistent selection without transient association falls through to ordinary combat. A prior handled=false is nonempty and already handled. Default virus chance 3 gives no guaranteed infection.

cases.title: Temporary48/persistent52 notice
cases.premises: The qualified first candidate chain of S09; all passed-party member levels [10,50], maximum 100, scaling map; final generation draws 0 and 4; normal core escape result 3.
cases.ordered_expected: Temporary individual is level 48; persistent combat participant is level 52. Cleanup precedes one notification carrying incoming level 48. Numbers are manual contract derivations.
cases.reverse: Revisit does not regenerate or rescale the persistent individual. A supplied existing individual avoids temporary generation. Direct species-token roaming input can complete cleanup and then fail while constructing notification arguments.

cases.title: Partner priority phases
cases.premises: Radar: valid grass and ordinary Land table, not cycling, battery 0, no initial chain, legal partner; 11×11 map with all ring candidates valid and presentation normal. Separate contest fixture: one selected player member, valid partner, two foes, no force-single, Safari or competing override.
cases.ordered_expected: Radar starts, increments usage and sets battery 50 before later partner-hook cancellation. Contest partner priority precedes the one-member rejection; a two-foe wrapper skips the single-foe contest override.
cases.reverse: Cycling blocks Radar startup. No partner, or force-single true, can produce a single contest candidate and reach its override. Shrinking the party alone cannot guarantee contest takeover.

cases.title: Accepted roaming adjacency
cases.premises: Default legal KYOGRE, switch 54 on, position 2, nonempty dedicated route; extra 1/32 gate fails.
cases.ordered_expected: Ordinary neighbors are only 21 and 31, equally likely. The complete dedicated four-key graph remains supplied.
cases.reverse: The extra gate can add 2 or 69 with multiplicity weight. No ordinary 2↔69 edge exists. Do not substitute the ten-key global graph or infer demo activation.

cases.title: Unchanged encounter identities and snapshots
cases.premises: Accepted valid level 11–14 slot, initial draw 11, HUSTLE percentage draw 0 versus GUTS. Separate repeated Land probability 70 followed by omitted probability; version 1 with grace 4, accumulator 210 and valid context.
cases.ordered_expected: HUSTLE gives 14; GUTS retains 11 without consuming that ability draw. Repeated type replaces slots but retains 70. Same-version input does not reload and retains 4/210.
cases.reverse: Changed version reloads grace to 0 while retaining accumulator 210; absent context only updates version; noninteger input is rejected before equality comparison. Saved rate 0→omitted text probability→successful recompile default 21 is distinct from the stale current-map snapshot. B14 changes neither these producers nor their determining inputs.
cases.clauses: WP36§3/5; originals; EN25-30; external B19 remains

cases.title: Virus date collection and independent generation
cases.premises: Last date is yesterday. Original party contains an infected egg plus infected non-egg I, cured C and uninfected N. Valid fields; no other writes.
cases.ordered_expected: Only I loses one duration unit; egg, C and N remain unchanged. Timestamp becomes today after the collection. Generation infection is a separate source; ordinary healing does not restore or reset virus.
cases.reverse: An infected egg alone satisfies the outer gate while the inner collection is empty; timestamp still updates. No infected member or an empty last timestamp prevents date processing. Forced general notifications do not add generation or hatch cycles.

cases.title: Berry common timestamp and stored mulch
cases.premises: Planted OLD plot, base duration 3 hours, stored GROWTHMULCH, first life, time_alive 0, stage 1, previous timestamp T−32400; sampled integer T, valid Rain category, no replant or other writes; later branch normally returns.
cases.ordered_expected: Effective stage duration 8100 seconds. Ordered common writes: time_alive 32400→stage 5→timestamp T; only then stage-water flag and Rain watering. The common timestamp also precedes NEW drying.
cases.reverse: Unplanted or elapsed≤0 returns before common writes. Ordinary OLD display does not settle. Without mulch, 9 hours gives stage 4. An explicitly artificial later weather-query failure cannot undo the preceding common writes; default reachability is unproved. Replant-limit reset returns on its separate earlier branch.

cases.title: GR012 data and neighboring berry changes
cases.premises: NEW CHERIBERRY, base 3 hours, drying 15, yield 2..5; planted with DAMPMULCH, moisture 100 and penalty 0; one 15-hour settlement, no watering, replant or additional writes; only yield queried. Separate qualified watering and flash fixtures.
cases.ordered_expected: Stage duration 13500 seconds and drying 7. At 14 hours moisture is 2; at 15 hours moisture −5, penalty 0, stage 5, yield 5; picking statistics unchanged. Water writes both records, with result feedback selected by current configuration. NEW transitions 4→5 and 8→2 request flash.
cases.reverse: Drying 14→7 and 1→0; do not clamp moisture to zero. Refusal writes nothing; already-watered stages do not increment again. OLD, unchanged, 0→1 and 1→0 do not request flash. No unconditional 67-entry compatibility promise.

cases.title: FLY partial failure versus successful tail
cases.premises: Direct FLY tool: valid destination D=(M,7,5), available individual, nonempty escape E, count N. Transfer, audio, refresh and presentation return normally. Optional callback changes no relevant state but throws; boundary cleanup returns normally.
cases.ordered_expected: Count N+1, location (M,7,5,down) and audio/refresh prefix are committed. Wait is not requested; E and D are not cleared; no normal return occurs; exception propagates. Only a separately lawful undisposed location-window update would observe D before timer reset/message/map-change gates.
cases.reverse: Absent callback, or normal nonmutating callback, plus normal subsequent wait/cleanup gives wait→boundary cleanup→E clear→D clear→true. No ordinary-menu callback reachability or continued game after the uncaught exception is asserted.

cases.title: Splash phase and neutral representation
cases.premises: Stable Rain-category strength 60, default four images, visible zero-based index 1; expired lifetime reset draws 0.40; valid resources and normal update.
cases.ordered_expected: Reset sets opacity 255 and immediately returns. Subsequent ordinary remaining lifetime 0.30 gives 0 and 0.19 gives 255; splash position stays stationary. No source class or slot layout is required.
cases.reverse: Index 0 is an ordinary raindrop. The reset update never also applies the ordinary hiding gate. Alternative representations can preserve ordered notifications, shared identities and domain states without source arrays.
